spans.s: cilimilika, nt., or ciliminikā (var.; so Mironov and BR), Mvy 〔8984〕, some kind of cloth, or article made of cloth (BR Halschmuck, clearly wrong); cf. Pali cilimikā, cimilikā; AMg. cilimiṇī, curtain, cloth used as curtain, also cilimiligā, ˚miliyā, ˚milī. Tib. bar thaṅ (? not in Dictt.); Chin. seems to mean mattress of coarse hair (or wool).
cilla, m. (Skt. Lex.), a kind of falcon: Mvy 〔4905〕 = Tib. ḥol bu (Jä. and Das ḥol pa, Das a kind of kite, Jä. vulture?).
